outcome: Perinatal outcomes (cesarean delivery rate, postpartum hemorrhage rate, newborn APGAR score, umbilical artery pH, birth weight)
cohort: 24 pregnant patients admitted to a single center for complications related to fibroids between 2008 and 2019
finding: Pain was the most common complication of fibroids during pregnancy, successfully managed conservatively in most cases, and most women delivered at term with good perinatal outcomes.
